description: List the complete bundled EUDR Annex I product catalogue. Use this for browsing commodity/code coverage; eudr_check_scope checks a particular code and explains partial matches. Returns products (commodity, codes and descriptions), removed products, applies_from dates, official sources and verified date, without pagination. The bundled acts and verified date bound freshness; ex lines cover only described goods, not every product under a code. Free keyless allowance: 10 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.
name: eudr_list_products
title: List EUDR products in scope
